name: Hamper Divination
body:
You can sneak past magic if the need arises.

Prerequisite(s): Stealth 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Your Stealth checks can evade divination spells and effects. For magic items, traps, and other effects. Compare your Stealth check to 15 + the caster level of the effect you are avoiding. Success means the divination does not perceive you as if you were successfully protected by the spell nondetection until you are discovered by other means (such as by a Perception check) or you end your Stealth. When using Stealth and encountering an active spell or when a spell is cast that would target you or include you in its area the caster must make a caster level check with a DC equal to 10 + your ranks in Stealth + your dexterity modifier. If this caster level check fails you are treated as if were successfully protected by the spell nondetection for the duration of the spell which triggered the check.
